name: lightning-visuals-operator
description: The Lightning Visuals HubSpot enrichment operator plugin — load contacts, preview cost, dispatch, watch the backend, and triage the review queue, conversationally.

plugins.name: operator-claude-plugin
plugins.description: Conversational front end for the n8n contact enrichment backend: load a contact spreadsheet, preview it with its provider-credit and token cost, and dispatch it to HubSpot. Also reports what the backend is doing and triages records waiting on a human. Read-only until you confirm a write.
